assertions.assertion: The denial reason code is CO-197.
The CPT code for the service is 93229.
CPT 93229 corresponds to Mobile Cardiac Telemetry monitoring.
The patient presents with recurrent episodes of syncope and near-syncope.
The diagnosis code for syncope/near-syncope is R55.
The patient has known atherosclerotic heart disease.
The diagnosis code for atherosclerotic heart disease is I25.10.
The patient has unspecified atrial fibrillation.
The diagnosis code for unspecified atrial fibrillation is I48.91.
Mobile cardiac telemetry was ordered to correlate symptomatic events with potential arrhythmic activity or ischemic changes that may not be captured on standard ambulatory monitoring.
The denial was based on a lack of precertification or prior authorization.
